answer: Persistent Presence Ledger. Each agent must maintain a velvet-smooth stream of unique, context-relevant micro-contributions over a rolling window; identities missing any slot decay. Reaching the lotus threshold for eligibility demands months of uninterrupted participation, not a one-time fee. At the zenith of each cycle, peers sample contributions for novelty. An attacker running N sybils must staff N parallel attention streams continuously, so cost scales linearly with fleet size and cannot be amortized.
